description: When will it rain next — When precipitation starts and stops at a US location: scans the National Weather Service hourly forecast (default next 48 h, up to 156) for hours at or above a chance threshold (default 40%) and returns WET NOW / RAIN SOON (within 6 h) / RAIN LATER / DRY, the next wet window with local start/end, duration, peak chance, type (rain, showers, thunderstorms, snow, sleet, freezing rain) and expected amount from gridpoint QPF, when it dries out if wet now, later windows and a 24-hour hourly strip. Params: lat+lon or place; hours; threshold. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: weather_next_rain
